moments.title: Founder as identity: the alien who builds
moments.insight: Charles defines himself first as a founder, calling it his core identity and 'icebergs' beneath capitalism.

moments.title: Why 'give your work for free' is toxic advice
moments.insight: He argues that free work undervalues young founders and blocks them from learning real fundamentals like ICP and offers.

moments.title: Comfort is a poison pill, retirement kills
moments.insight: Charles claims safety and comfort are traps, citing that retirees statistically die sooner due to lost purpose.

moments.title: The physical reset: 30k runs and 1000 push-ups
moments.insight: When plateauing, he forces hard physical resets like ultra runs and thousand-rep workouts to biochemically 'reboot' himself.
